annotations.title: Who lives within a few miles of this site?

description: Use when the user is choosing or underwriting a site for a store, restaurant, clinic, school or property and asks about the catchment: "how many people live within 3 miles?", "what is household income around this address?", "how many schools are nearby?". Returns population, households, mean household income, the renter share and density within the radius, from Census ACS 5-year block groups, plus the number of public schools from NCES. A straight-line circle, not drive time. Refuses before you are charged if the area is empty or the totals fail their checks. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one release (ACS 5-year); place: address or lat/lon, radius_miles. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For whether the site is in an Opportunity Zone or NMTC tract, use run_incentive_tracts; for a whole city’s housing supply against rent, use run_city_profile.
